spans.s: stomita, ppp. (= Pali thomita, to thometi = Skt. Dhātup. stomayati, denom. to stoma), praised: ˚taḥ Mvy 〔2614〕; stutaḥ ˚to varṇitaḥ praśasto Bhīk 〔24a.4〕; devaśatasahasra-stuta-˚ta- (Lefm. staumita, wrongly)-varṇitapraśaṃsitasya LV 〔7.22〕 (prose). Most mss. stomito, for Lefm. stemito, q.v., in LV 〔230.9〕.
